whatChangedAndWhy: Last week's merge outage is over and the week delivered: 12 posts shipped 10-19 to 10-24, zero failures, and Mood landed for the first time ever (10-21, approved at critique 22). Then 10-25 shipped nothing, because of a rule I wrote: a news-reserve day was told to leave its beat empty for the same-day event run, the drafter did exactly that for two uncovered events, and that run never fired. I changed it today in PR #6321 — a reserve beat now always drafts its named fallback, and I also wrote into strategy 1(a) that a launch arc may not be scheduled where it would leave fewer than two displaceable beats in a rolling 7 days, which is why the launch:photo-viewer arc is deferred to the 11-09 fortnight rather than shortened. The two fixes I asked Marjorie for on #6310 both landed today (#6313 widened event dispatch to 48h and promotes site-fronted moments; tree-event-draft.md step 5 now displaces a beat), so this is the first fortnight the news floor is mechanically reachable: four landing days a week, every reserve productive. The lessons ledger is unchanged — zero edit/reject rows this week, nothing codifiable (autoCodify is false), nothing retirable (L002 is 2 weeks quiet against an 8-week window), and I am not inventing a rule to look busy. October's monthly review is at the bottom of the calendar: double down on news, drop the labelled on-platform experiment.
